batch_node.name: vuln_mosaic refresh schedule
batch_node.description: Seeds the tap_cares schedule that fires vuln_mosaic:refresh hourly. See req-vuln-mosaic-refresh in specs/spec-vuln-mosaic-v0.md.

data.cost_per_fire: No credential and no grid reads. One fire is one git fetch of cvelistV5 (about one second when nothing changed) plus one conditional download each for the CISA KEV catalog and the EPSS scores, and one conditional download per opted-in OSV ecosystem. No quota applies to these sources.

node.name: vuln_mosaic refresh
node.description: Refreshes the local copies of public vulnerability data (CVE records, CISA KEV, EPSS, and NVD and OSV where enabled). Runs at :41 past each hour, off the top-of-hour scheduler tick; cvelistV5 commits roughly every ten minutes, so an hourly cadence keeps the data well inside its three-day staleness limit. A run that finds any source failed or stale ends as a failed collection job naming it. Disable or re-time this freely; Schedule is user-editable.
